planets.name: TOI-201 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-201 with a 2800-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-201 c was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around TOI-201. Its orbit and size follow Mireles et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
